name: nsu-companion
description: NSU Companion - merged workspace (Authentication, Admin Management, Backend)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend-authentication && npm install --prefix frontend-admin && npm install --prefix gateway
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,AUTH,ADMIN,GATEWAY -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend-authentication" "npm run dev --prefix frontend-admin" "npm run dev --prefix gateway"
scripts.test: py test.py || python3 test.py || python test.py
